title: Which tool results still matter?
painline: Pain: /compact-style summaries invent soft memory. This demo: keep or drop raw tool spans — zero rewrites.
prompt: Use DecisionHarness Choice keep|drop over tool-result spans before compacting history. Never summarize/rewrite. For Claude Code /compact UX, see complementary specialist fast-jev-compaction; use jev-harness when keep/drop must live in your loop with shadow + eval.

title: Stop paying frontier for FAQ
painline: Pain: easy turns burn the expensive model. This demo routes canned prompts with tier Choice + risk Score.
prompt: Wire recipes/confidence-front-door/model-router.ts. Policy: risk≥1.5 → frontier else tier. Shadow soak; compare your $ and p50 to always-frontier on YOUR traffic.

title: Ship gate before the incident
equation: Ungated ship = incident $; gate = fewer bad deploys + faster catch
painline: Pain: a fluent wrong answer ships as truth. This demo runs verify-gate policy over canned outputs.
prompt: Use recipes/verify-gate/llm-verifier.ts on customer-facing or deploy-bound outputs. Block on jailbreak/verdict; revise if ungrounded. Shadow first.

title: Pager burn → sleep
equation: Alert flood = pager burn; gate = eng-hours $ + sleep
painline: Pain: flapping + duplicates page humans. This demo gates a canned alert stream.
prompt: Run recipes/confidence-front-door/alert-gate.ts per alert. Shadow first; promote when fixtures match on-call labels.

title: Semantic WHERE without embeddings
equation: LLM-per-row = $ + wallclock; Jev batch demo = ¢ + ms
painline: Pain: judging each row with a chat model. This demo maps one NL predicate over canned rows and meters OUR wall time + $.
prompt: Use recipes/row-judgment/row-semantic-match.ts. Include/exclude/review from Noul+confidence. Measure YOUR rows — do not cite others' posts as proof.

title: Click without a vision agent
equation: Vision-agent loop = $ + seconds; candidate Choice = ms + ¢
painline: Pain: shipping pixels every click. This demo: local labels → Choice → act loop; we meter OUR step wall time + $.
prompt: Perceive DOM/OCR locally. recipes/candidate-action-selection — Choice over ids + done Noul. Never send pixels to Jev. Measure YOUR loop.
